ttl.description: Duration the cached result will be valid for. Must be a valid duration string (e.g., '60s', '5m', '1h').

stale.description: Duration after which the result will be asynchronously refreshed. Must be a valid duration string.

warm.description: Asynchronously execute and cache the given command, even if it's already cached.

force.description: Execute and cache the given command, even if it's already cached.

cwd.description: Include the current working directory in the cache key.

env.description: List of environment variable names to include in the cache key. Variables must be valid names (e.g., 'PATH', 'HOME').

modtime.description: List of file paths whose modification time should be included in the cache key.

discard_failures.description: Do not cache invocations that fail (non-zero exit code).

scope.description: If set, all cached data will be scoped to this value to prevent collisions.

cache_dir.description: Directory under which to persist cached invocations. Defaults to system temp dir if unset.
